from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689869/attempts/bb90a5c04b7e45689f74d9e2a14a4f73/system/state/workspace/programs/task-5f41b3a4.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    """Extend each row's rightmost non-background feature to the right edge in color 1."""
    out = [list(row) for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    width = len(out[0])
    for row in out:
        occupied = [i for i, value in enumerate(row) if value != background]
        if occupied:
            right = max(occupied)
            for i in range(right + 1, width):
                row[i] = 1
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
print(p.read_text())
